name: What if the Lyft driver was uninsured or underinsured?

mainEntity.name: What if the Lyft driver was uninsured or underinsured?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the at-fault Lyft driver was uninsured or underinsured, it complicates matters but does not necessarily mean you cannot recover compensation. Lyft's corporate insurance policy often provides coverage in these situations, up to certain limits, depending on the driver's status at the time of the crash. Additionally, your own uninsured/underinsured motorist (UM/UIM) coverage on your personal auto policy might apply. An attorney can help explore all available avenues for recovery.
acceptedAnswer.description: If an at-fault Lyft driver is uninsured or underinsured, Lyft's corporate policy or your personal UM/UIM coverage may provide compensation; an attorney can help explore options.
